name: play_store_get_app_rating
intent: Get the star rating of an app in the Google Play Store
description: Open the Google Play Store, find the requested app, open its listing, and read its average star rating from the details page without installing it.
patterns: what is the star rating of an app
check an app's rating in the Play Store
how many stars does an app have
find an app's Play Store rating

inputs.name: app_name
inputs.description: The app whose star rating is requested

steps.intent: Tap the {{app_name}} result to open its listing and see its star rating
